campaign.worker_scope: Shared ranks and potential numerical-library workers. MPI progress threads blocked in poll or epoll were recorded separately.
campaign.allocation_limit_note: The remaining nonreserved time was close to one cold factor cost. Measured direction amplification and contraction did not support repeating the solve.

outcome.next_discriminator: At the exact frozen accepted base, measure achievable true physical and scaled original linear errors versus scaled correction size, resolving the measured constitutive sensitivity before accepting another direction. Preserve original nonlinear acceptance.

attempts.controls: Current FD 512e-6 and factor FD 4e-6 on the exact R8 field.
attempts.outcome: Five accepted steps, low original contraction, late fixed-rule diffusion sensitivity.

attempts.controls: Same late vector and field, one larger no-factor panel.
attempts.outcome: 2048e-6 cleared the tested allowances and original linear targets.

attempts.controls: Two feasible matched fractions at 2048e-6 with the same base, direction and factor.
attempts.outcome: Both auxiliary solves missed their budgets and candidate sizes exceeded the limits. A small ordinary fallback was accepted.

attempts.controls: Fixed-rule product difference on the original late baseline vector.
attempts.outcome: Physical k difference moved from 1.549e-6 to 1.386e-6 and remained above budget.

attempts.controls: Exact fixed-rule tangent plus complete moving-rule FD.
attempts.outcome: Spacing difference fell to 4.636e-8 physical and 7.009e-7 scaled.

attempts.controls: Same latest curvature vector, hybrid operator at the prospective panel.
attempts.outcome: Coarse hybrid solve vetoed before a new factor. The 512e-6 and 256e-6 pair met sensitivity. The old vector still failed fresh linear checks.

attempts.controls: New Krylov at 512e-6, factor assembly at 4e-6, fixed-rule tangent and ordinary Armijo.
attempts.outcome: One accepted update with negligible reduction. Larger terminal direction failed physical sensitivity.

attempts.controls: Replay the exact last vector and separate original momentum terms.
attempts.outcome: Bitwise primary and half action replay. Constitutive momentum dominated the terminal physical spacing difference.

BEST_B3_STATE_REPRODUCED.evidence: Exact signed coefficients, equation bindings and six original blocks in the current-source replay.

MERIT_REJECTED_DIRECTION_CAPTURE_VERIFIE.evidence: Focused custody controls and three actual saved ACTION_UNRESOLVED directions. Representative feasible rejected-trial identities verified.

CURRENT_DIRECTION_ACCURACY_RESOLVED.evidence: Scoped frozen repair and first rebuilt hybrid direction passed. Terminal hybrid physical allowance 1.1064e-6 exceeds 9.6576e-7. Constitutive momentum sensitivity is localized.

ORIGINAL_PROGRESS_RATE_ASSESSED.evidence: Seven actual original updates give 0.04318% overall improvement. Last two decreases were 2.207e-12 and 1.443e-13.

COUPLED_CURVATURE_REMEDY_ASSESSED.evidence: One-sided, size and restart controls pass. Both matched B3 auxiliary solves were ineffective under the declared error and size budgets.

B3_ORIGINAL_ROOT_QUALIFIED.evidence: Native maximum 6.43842e-6 versus 1e-10. Independent k exceeds its limit.

NEXT_SPATIAL_DISCRIMINATOR_COMPLETED.evidence: Qualified third pair needed to select the next spatial solve.

ADVERSE_ORIGINAL_BRANCH_RESOLUTION_SUPPO.evidence: Retained sampled response positive. Converged independent branch evidence pending.
